title: Op-eds connect scientists and communities | Science
content: On 16 June, I watched as articles supporting science appeared in local newspapers across the United States. A professor in Salt Lake City, Utah, described how a love for science drove her to become a first-generation college graduate. A doctoral student from Yakima, Washington, wrote about how his decision to research plant science was motivated by growing up in the largest apple-producing country in the United States. A student from Marietta, Georgia, detailed how federal research produced pacemakers that saved her life.
